summary: Idira agentless web service (formerly CyberArk AAM) that hands passwords from the Idira PAM vault to applications over REST.
value: Passwords are removed from application code and configs.
Passwords change by policy without application downtime.
The audit log shows who got which password, when and from where.
simple: An agentless web service that delivers passwords from the Idira Privileged Access Manager vault to applications through REST requests over HTTPS (formerly CyberArk AAM, Application Access Manager) — with nothing installed on the application server. It verifies the application by address, certificate (mutual TLS) and other attributes before handing over a password. Removes passwords from code and configuration, lets them rotate by policy without downtime, and audits who retrieved a password, when and from where. Licensed per web service server.
classification: The class is secrets management; Idira Conjur (open source) stays in the text.
